artworks.title: Peter with a Gunshot Wound in His Forehead
artworks.medium: drypoint
artworks.description: The image depicts a close-up of a person's face. The individual's features are shown in detail, including wide eyes, arched eyebrows, distinct lines around the mouth, and short, dark hair. The expression is intense, with tears drawn as black streaks running down the face. The image is in black and grey tones, with a blank background focusing solely on the face.

artworks.title: Robert in the Theater
artworks.medium: drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image consists of jagged lines and angular shapes creating an intricate abstract composition. One prominent figure in the foreground appears to have exaggerated, elongated features. In the background, there are blurred and distorted figures. The overall composition suggests a bustling cityscape filled with shadowy, overlapping forms, evoking a sense of depth and motion.

artworks.title: Scene in the Cafe with the Cripple
artworks.medium: drypoint
artworks.description: The image shows an elongated figure with exaggerated facial features, including large eyes and a high forehead, standing with one hand gesturing forward. The person is dressed in a long, tattered robe and the hair is dark and swept back. Surrounding the figure are smaller sketchy figures, and the background is filled with lines and abstract forms.

artworks.title: Head in Profile
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on heavy-wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a close-up profile view of a person's face, showing their head and features in detailed lines. The person is positioned to the left, looking to the right. Their facial features are defined with strong lines, including a prominent nose, large eye, and pronounced lips. Their hair is stylized with curved lines. Clothing is not visible. In the background, there is textured shading and a faint minimalistic figure resembling a standing nude with outstretched arms. The artwork is on a grainy, textured surface, with the artist's signature visible at the bottom.

artworks.title: Woman with a Necklace
artworks.medium: color etching printed in blue on wove cream paper
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a person's body, from the head down to the waist. The person is upright and facing the viewer directly. The facial features are stylized, with exaggerated brows and intricate patterns on the forehead and eyes. The hair is long and flowing around the face. The person is wearing a top with visible buttons, along with a necklace made of small circular beads and larger flower-like shapes. The background has a textured pattern.

artworks.title: Girl with Hand
artworks.medium: etching on laid cream paper
artworks.description: The image is an artistic etching featuring a close-up of a person's head and shoulders. The person is depicted with their hands positioned in front of them, partially obscuring the lower portion of their face. The person's face is characterized by prominent etching lines that highlight their eyes, nose, and mouth, creating a textured appearance. Their hair appears to be medium-length, framing the face with soft, curved lines. The clothing is not distinctly visible due to the abstract nature of the artwork. The background is filled with dark, textured shading, providing contrast to the lighter tone of the person's face and hands.

artworks.title: Tired Soldier I
artworks.medium: drypoint on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a stylized representation of a person's upper body. The person's head is turned slightly towards the viewer with an abstract and angular facial expression. Their hair appears to be short and styled upwards. They are seated, leaning slightly to the side with one elbow resting on an unseen armrest, and holding an object in their hand. Their clothing is suggested with simple lines, possibly a jacket or coat. The background is minimally detailed with vertical lines, focusing attention on the subject. The image has a sketch-like quality, emphasizing simplicity and abstraction in the depiction.

artworks.title: Tired Man (Self-Portrait)
artworks.medium: color etching and aquatint on wove buff paper
artworks.description: The image shows a head and shoulders portrait of a person with a relaxed facial expression and closed eyes. The facial features are thin and gaunt, with pronounced lines suggesting a mature age. The person's hair is light and sweeps upward. They are wearing a dark green garment, possibly a shirt or robe. There is no visible jewelry. The background is a dark, textured surface.

artworks.title: Man in a Room, Self-portrait
artworks.medium: color etching printed in black and green on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows an abstract and sketch-like portrayal of a person's face and partial upper torso. The face is depicted from the front, emphasizing facial features extending down to part of the shoulders. The facial features are exaggerated with deep lines and shadowing, showing large eyes, a broad nose, and a severe mouth outlined with dark, jagged strokes. The hair is sporadically sketched around the crown in a rough manner. The person is wearing a garment in a dark green hue that extends slightly below the neckline. In the background, abstract lines and shapes are present.

artworks.title: Smiling Head, Self-portrait (Lächelnder Kopf, Selbstporträt)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving, printed in black and green
artworks.description: The image features a stylized portrait of an individual's head and shoulders. The person is shown facing forward with abstract, angular facial features which include darkly shaded eyes, a pronounced nose, and a slight smile. The hair is depicted in short, combed-back lines. The individual is wearing a garment with a high, rounded collar in a textured style matching the portrait's overall artistic representation. There are no visible accessories or objects in the person's hands. The background has a textured, abstract pattern with strokes radiating from the center, in a muted blue-green color that covers the entire piece.

artworks.title: Bust of a Weary Man, Self-portrait (Ermüdender Kopf, Selbstporträt)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving, printed in green and red
artworks.description: The image displays a close-up artistic depiction of a person's head and shoulders. The person's head is slightly tilted, and their gaze is directed forward. The facial features are abstract and heavily stylized, with exaggerated eyes, nose, and lips. The hair is depicted with sharp, linear strokes that create a textured appearance, with a reddish area near the forehead. The person appears to be wearing a garment with visible horizontal lines suggesting clothing. The background consists of a textured, cloudy effect, with swirling patterns blending into the figure. No visible jewelry or handheld objects are present in the artwork.

artworks.title: Gloomy Face, Self-portrait (Dunkles Gesicht, Selbstporträt)
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, and drypoint
artworks.description: The image depicts an abstract representation of a person's upper body and head positioned upright and facing forward. Facial features are minimally represented with emphasis on the eyes, nose, and mouth, accompanied by some shading. The hair is loosely sketched and short. The individual appears to wear a collared garment with simple outlines and indications of buttons or fastenings. The background is plain and unadorned, reflecting the drawing style. No jewelry or objects are visible in the person's hands.

artworks.title: The Couple, Self-Portrait with Wife (Das Paar, Selbstporträt mit Frau)
artworks.medium: drypoint, printed in blue-green, on wove paper
artworks.description: The image features intersecting lines and curves creating an abstract composition. In the foreground, shapes and lines suggest two heads, one with human-like features and the other with feline-like features, merging into each other. The background has a textured pattern resembling a rough canvas or gritty wall.

artworks.title: Tired Woman, Sonia Gramatté (Müder Mädchenkopf, Sonia Gramatté)
artworks.medium: engraving and etching, printed in black with blue-green and red wiping
artworks.description: The image depicts a profile view of a person with stylized facial features, short wavy hair, and a textured garment. The person appears contemplative, with their head slightly downturned. The background features swirling lines in a deep teal color.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome Penitent in the Wilderness
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Joan and David Maxwell Fund, Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund and The Ahmanson Foundation
artworks.description: Printed with black lines on light tan paper, a balding, bearded, muscular man kneels next to a small lion in a rocky landscape in this vertical engraving. The man’s beard comes down beyond his chest, and his hair is long behind his receding hairline. His torso is bare while his lower body is wrapped in a cloth that falls in deep folds. He faces our left, gazing at a broken tree trunk with a cluster of weeds growing near its roots. A small crucifix is thrust into the broken trunk. He holds a rock in his outstretched right hand, on our left. The lion crouches next to him with his eyebrows gathered low as he looks off to our left. Beyond them, a landscape rises along either side of a path leading toward a church in the distance. On the left side are the cracked walls of a building with plants growing out the top. On the right is the craggy face of a cliff with tall, slender trees growing on its top slope. The path darkens as it passes the cliff and reaches the church to our left of center. In the far distance to the right of the cliff is a castle-like structure with square towers. Deep shadows around the man and lion and along the path are created with areas of densely spaced, black hatched lines, and unmarked areas create bright highlights. The artist signed the work with monogram made of a capital D tucked between the legs of an uppercase A.

artworks.title: Nude on the Beach
artworks.medium: blue crayon on buff wove paper
artworks.description: This drawing shows bold, sweeping, dark blue lines on beige paper, creating an abstract composition. Some of the lines on the left appear to outline an abstract female figure seen from the knees up with no distinct facial features. There are other curving lines and shapes surrounding this figure, but they have no distinct form.

artworks.title: Girl Before a Mirror
artworks.medium: graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows abstract figures outlined with fluid pencil strokes. Two figures are depicted with bold, gestural lines, varying in thickness to define their forms and pose. The composition is expressive and spontaneous, capturing quick visual impressions on paper. The drawing conveys a sense of interaction or connection between the figures, set against a neutral backdrop.

artworks.title: Bust of a Young Man, Self-portrait (Knabenkopf, Selbstporträt)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving, printed in green with red ink applied with fingertips
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person from the head up. The person is facing slightly to their right. The facial features are drawn with pronounced lines, including the eyes, nose, and mouth. The hair is short and styled upwards with curved and straight lines. There are reddish tones on the cheeks and nose. The clothing includes a collar detail. The background is textured with a speckled appearance.

artworks.title: Man at the Sea, Self-portrait (Mann am Meer, Selbstporträt)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving, with black and green wiping
artworks.description: The image shows the head and shoulders of a person against a backdrop resembling a landscape or sky. The person's head is slightly tilted to the left in a three-quarter stance. Their facial features are rendered with bold, expressive lines creating a stylized appearance with hair drawn in sweeping lines suggesting a parted style. The features include pronounced eyebrows, eyes, and mouth outlined with thick lines. The clothing appears to be textured fabric, possibly a collared shirt, indicated by intersecting lines forming a grid pattern. There are no visible jewelry or objects held by the person. The background features abstract floating shapes that may represent clouds or formations, with a field of color below suggesting water or land in shades of teal and white.

artworks.title: Montmarte
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on wove cream paper
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with people on a set of steps and surrounding walkways. The point of view is from an elevated perspective. The horizon is not visibly distinct. The etching style features delicate, cross-hatched and linear brushstrokes creating texture and depth. The overall color palette is monochromatic, with soft, sepia-toned hues. Closest to us, a woman is ascending the stairs, with other figures scattered throughout. Buildings and trees fill the background with intricate linework.

artworks.title: Boat and Trees
artworks.medium: woodcut in black, hand colored with watercolor, on Japan paper
artworks.description: The image shows interlocking triangles and curved shapes. Green triangular forms rise upward against a black background. There is a red boat-like shape and blue zigzag shapes at the bottom, with orange arcs hinting at a sun. Rounded shapes on the side resemble leafy tree canopies.

artworks.title: Tree
artworks.medium: woodcut in black on Japan paper
artworks.description: The image displays a series of bold, black geometric shapes and jagged lines against a light background, creating strong contrast. The artwork resembles fragmented patterns without clear subject matter, allowing viewers to interpret the shapes and lines in their own way.

artworks.title: Composition
artworks.medium: color woodcut on Japan paper
artworks.description: The image displays an array of bold lines and jagged shapes forming an abstract composition. Black lines create partitions filled with rich colors resembling stained glass sections. The colors - red, green, yellow, and blue - form shapes that may suggest a landscape with a river, hills, and a dynamic sky. The composition resembles a puzzle with irregular pieces, encouraging viewers to find familiar objects within the abstraction.

artworks.title: Still Life
artworks.medium: woodcut in black on Japan paper
artworks.description: The image displays bold, overlapping lines and shapes forming an intricate design. It combines circular, angular, and wavy lines, suggesting a complex harmony. A central portion features curved, layered lines resembling a seashell or concentric rings. Surrounding this center are jagged, stepped edges and zigzag patterns reminiscent of a city skyline or gears. Light and shadow play create a dynamic tension within the design.
